values: Board 1 · gateway, three leaves, FTDI and EEPROM · notes reconciled 2026-09-07
264 pad rows: SAMs 3 × 48, STM32 64, FTDI 48 and EEPROM 8. All allocations remain unverified; no Board 1 CAD exists.
FD_CAN_A uses CAN0 PA24/PA25. FD_CAN_B uses CAN1 PB10/PB11. Each has its own PHY and provisional STB GPIO.
Multidrop uses SERCOM0 PA08/PA09. Ring uses SERCOM1 PA16/PA17. Both propose TXPO=0, RXPO=1. Exact baud rates remain TBD.
SAM0 pad25 → SAM1 pad26 (B1-L04); SAM1 pad25 → SAM2 pad26 (B1-L05); SAM2 pad25 → SAM0 pad26 (B1-L06).
ADR-033/039 select the second LV125 and pulls: TX to /OE, A to GND, Y to UART_MD; RX senses the bus. Reset/ramp behavior and rate remain unqualified.
PA14/PA15 pads23/24 are XIN/XOUT. Leaf crystal and initial load capacitors are accepted; see B1-B020/043. Startup/drive/loading remain B1-Q008.
PA30/pad45 SWCLK; PA31/pad46 SWDIO; pad40 RESET. SWD header MPN B1-B009 is accepted; numbering, footprint and probe/cable compatibility remain open.
Four GPIOs per MCU and LED/resistor parts are accepted. Leaf pad choices PA02/PA03/PB08/PB09 and LED PA27 remain draft; load/protection and LED drive need review.
VDDIN/VDDIO/VDDANA use 3V3_SYS. Each VDDCORE has its own accepted ceramic capacitor pair B1-B040/041; never join core outputs or tie them to 3V3_SYS.
Unused means no connection or future footprint reserved. Firmware input/pull configuration remains to review. PA00/PA01 are not assigned a 32 kHz crystal.
Check exact -AUT ordering/package drawing, current documents and errata against actual silicon revision, electrical margins, clock tree, drive/startup and footprint.
DS80000740E identifies ATSAMC21G17A on p.2. Silicon revision is TBD; applicable CAN/USART/clock workarounds are not yet signed off.
DS60001479J. Pinout p.22; SAM C21 E/G/J mux Table 6-2 pp.29–30; oscillator and debug Tables 6-5/6-6 p.34; USART CTRLA p.505.
TCAN3413: TXD pin1, RXD pin4, STB pin8 with internal pull-up. Independent standby GPIOs are proposals.
MCU and separate FTDI crystals are finalized; initial load capacitors are accepted. B1-B014/019/020/042/043/058 own the parts; oscillator qualification remains open.
SAM0 B1-P025–072; SAM1 B1-P073–120; SAM2 B1-P121–168; STM32 B1-P169–232; FTDI/EEPROM B1-P233–288. Parent groups B1-P001–024 retained.
Board 1 pinmap; next unused ID B1-P289
Notes reflect ADR-039 baseline. Signal/peripheral/mux choices remain draft. Source citations and accepted MPNs do not establish electrical verification.
